name: tg-cerber
description: Search and summarise your company's protected Telegram work archive, and check accounts, sessions and security in Cerber for Business, within the access an administrator approves.

interface.longDescription:
Cerber for Business protects the Telegram accounts a company's employees use for work, and keeps an encrypted archive of their work conversations that the company controls. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with that archive and with the protection itself, inside one organization and only within what an administrator approves.

When you connect, you sign in to Cerber, choose which accounts ChatGPT may read, and choose what it may do. Reading is the default. Acting on accounts, changing security settings, managing administrators and deleting archived data are separate permissions that are off unless you tick them, and ticking them asks for your console password. ChatGPT acts as you and can never do more than your role allows; every request is recorded in your organization's journal.

With the archive permission ChatGPT can list chats and folders, read conversations page by page, search across accounts (including document text and voice transcripts), see who was in a group, see every earlier version of an edited message and messages that were deleted in Telegram, and open photos, voice notes and documents.

With the organization permissions ChatGPT can report on accounts, Telegram sessions and their review deadlines, departments, administrators, the security journal and system status, and, if you allow it, approve or end sessions, pause protection, move accounts between departments, or start a backup.

To read the archive, Cerber's server keeps your archive password with this connection and decrypts on ChatGPT's behalf; disconnecting deletes it. Organizations that need the password never to leave their computers can use the local mode described in the documentation.
defaultPrompt: Find what we agreed with a client about delivery and quote the message.
Summarise a colleague's client conversations from last week.
Which of our Telegram accounts need attention right now?
